versions.content: Semantics of SwAxisGeneric . swGenericAxisParam in the definition of a fix axis The role SwAxisGeneric . swGenericAxisParam provides the actual numeric values for the definition of the axis. The semantics of a provided numerical value is clarified by the attribute SwGeneri- cAxisParamType . category where meta-class SwGenericAxisParamType is ref- erenced in the role swGenericAxisParamType .
